newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank lifts rediscount rate to 10.7.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank lifts rediscount rate to 10.7.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Friday it will raise the rediscount rate to 10.7 percent in December from the current 10.528 percent.
The new rate is computed one percent below the 91-day T-bill rate of the last auction in November.
The rediscount window of the Central Bank is not used as a monetary tool. It is aimed at giving concessional terms to exporters and the farm sector.
From January to November 22, loans from the Central Bank's rediscounting facility reached 7.788 billion pesos, the Central Bank statement said.
Of this amount, 4.732 billion pesos or 60.8 percent went to exporters and the rest to the farm sector.
